# Adaptedness classification of dual purpose breeds

## Across milk yields

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)

europe_data<-raw_data |> filter(Country%in% c(europe_countries <- c(
  "Albania", "Andorra", "Austria", "Belarus", "Belgium",
  "Bosnia and Herzegovina", "Bulgaria", "Croatia", "Cyprus",
  "Czechia", "Denmark", "Estonia", "Finland", "France",
  "Germany", "Greece", "Hungary", "Iceland", "Ireland",
  "Italy", "Latvia", "Liechtenstein", "Lithuania", "Luxembourg",
  "Malta", "Moldova", "Monaco", "Montenegro", "Netherlands",
  "North Macedonia", "Norway", "Poland", "Portugal", "Romania",
  "Russia", "San Marino", "Serbia", "Slovakia", "Slovenia",
  "Spain", "Sweden", "Switzerland", "Ukraine", "United Kingdom"
)))

provision_use_table <- europe_data |> filter(!is.na(`Provision Uses`)) |> count (`Provision Uses`, name = "No of Breeds", sort = TRUE)

provision_use_table <- europe_data |>
  filter(!is.na(`Provision Uses`)) |>
  count(`Provision Uses`, name = "Number of breeds") |>
  arrange(`Provision Uses`)

table(europe_data$`Provision Uses`)

```

```{r}
milk_data <- europe_data |>
  mutate(
    Purpose = case_when(
      
      # Contains BOTH meat and milk
      str_detect(`Provision Uses`, regex("meat", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
        str_detect(`Provision Uses`, regex("milk", ignore_case = TRUE))
      ~ "Dual purpose",
      
      # Contains milk but NOT meat
      str_detect(`Provision Uses`, regex("milk", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
        !str_detect(`Provision Uses`, regex("meat", ignore_case = TRUE))
      ~ "Dairy",
      
      # Contains meat but NOT milk
      str_detect(`Provision Uses`, regex("meat", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
        !str_detect(`Provision Uses`, regex("milk", ignore_case = TRUE))
      ~ "Meat",
      
      # Everything else
      TRUE ~ "Other / Unclassified"
    ),
    
    .after = `Provision Uses`
  )
view(milk_data)

table(milk_data$Purpose)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

tabledata <- europe_data |>
  mutate(
    Production_Purpose = case_when(
      
      # Contains BOTH meat and milk
      str_detect(`Provision Uses`, regex("meat", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
        str_detect(`Provision Uses`, regex("milk", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Dual Purpose",
      
      # Contains milk but NOT meat
      str_detect(`Provision Uses`, regex("milk", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
        !str_detect(`Provision Uses`, regex("meat", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Dairy",
      
      # Contains meat but NOT milk
      str_detect(`Provision Uses`, regex("meat", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
        !str_detect(`Provision Uses`, regex("milk", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Meat",
      
      # Everything else
      TRUE ~ "Others"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
final_classification_table <- tabledata |>
  mutate(
    Adaptedness = replace_na(
      `Breed classification (adaptedness)`,
      "NA"
    )
  ) |>
  count(Production_Purpose, Adaptedness) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Adaptedness,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))
  )
final_classification_table <- final_classification_table |>
  bind_rows(
    final_classification_table |>
      summarise(
        Production_Purpose = "Total",
        across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
      )
  )

final_classification_table

final_classification_table
```

```{r}
dual_purpose<- milk_data |> select(ISO3,`Provision Uses`,`Milk per year AVG`,Purpose, `Breed classification (adaptedness)`,`Efabis milk protein AVG`,`Milk fat AVG (%)`,`Milk yield per lactation (kg) AVG`,`Carcass weight (kg)`)
dual_purpose <- dual_purpose |>
  mutate(
    Adaptedness = if_else(
      is.na(`Breed classification (adaptedness)`),
      "NA",
      `Breed classification (adaptedness)`
    )
  )

```

```{r}
unique(dual_purpose$Adaptedness)
```

### Milk yield per lactation across breeds

```{r}
dual_purpose_milk<-dual_purpose |> 
  filter(Purpose%in% c("Dairy","Dual purpose"))
```

```{r}
table(
 dual_purpose_milk$Adaptedness,
  dual_purpose_milk$Purpose
)
```

```{r}
summary(dual_purpose_milk$`Milk yield per lactation (kg) AVG`)

dual_purpose_milk |>
  count(Adaptedness, Purpose)
```

```{r}
dual_purpose_milk |>
  select(Adaptedness, Purpose) |>
  distinct()
```

```{r}
ggplot(

) +
```


# t-test

```{r}
t.test(
  `Milk yield per lactation (kg) AVG` ~ Purpose,
  data = dual_purpose_milk
)

t.test(
  `Milk per year AVG` ~ Purpose,
  data = dual_purpose_milk
)

t.test(
  `Efabis milk protein AVG` ~ Purpose,
  data = dual_purpose_milk
)

t.test(
  `Milk fat AVG (%)` ~ Purpose,
  data = dual_purpose_milk
)

t.test(
  `Carcass weight (kg)` ~ Purpose,
  data = dual_purpose_meat
)
```

Does the relationship between Production Purpose and carcass weight differ depending on Adaptedness?

# Anova

#### Meat/ Carcass weight

```{r}
meat_model_data <- dual_purpose_meat |>
  filter(Adaptedness != "NA")
meat_model <- lm(
  `Carcass weight (kg)` ~ Purpose * Adaptedness,
  data = meat_model_data
)
anova(meat_model)
```

#### Milk yield per lactation

```{r}
milk_model_data <- dual_purpose_milk |>
  filter(Adaptedness != "NA")

milk_lactation_model <- lm(
  `Milk yield per lactation (kg) AVG` ~ Purpose * Adaptedness,
  data = milk_model_data
)

anova(milk_lactation_model)
```

#### Milk yield per year

```{r}
milk_model <- lm(
  `Milk per year AVG` ~ Purpose * Adaptedness,
  data = milk_model_data
)

anova(milk_model)
```

#### Milk protein

```{r}
milk_model <- lm(
  `Efabis milk protein AVG` ~ Purpose * Adaptedness,

)

anova(milk_model)
```

#### Milk fat

```{r}

anova(milk_model)
```

## Checking the zero values

```{r}
zero_milk <- europe_data |>
  filter(`Milk per year AVG` == 0) |> 
  select(`Milk per year AVG`,`Milk yield per lactation (kg) AVG`,`Efabis milk protein AVG`,`Milk fat AVG (%)`,`Carcass weight (kg)`,`Breed classification (adaptedness)`, `Provision Uses`)

View(zero_milk)
```

Checking the overlap in zero values

```{r}
zero_check <- europe_data |>
  mutate(
    zero_year = `Milk per year AVG` == 0,
    zero_lactation = `Milk yield per lactation (kg) AVG` == 0,
    zero_protein = `Efabis milk protein AVG` == 0,
    zero_fat = `Milk fat AVG (%)` == 0,
    zero_carcass = `Carcass weight (kg)` == 0
  ) |>
  filter(if_any(starts_with("zero_"), ~ !is.na(.x) & .x))

View(zero_check)
```

```{r}
carcass_check <- dual_purpose_meat |>
  filter(
    !is.na(`Carcass weight (kg)`),
    `Carcass weight (kg)` > 0
  )

t.test(
  `Carcass weight (kg)` ~ Purpose,
  data = carcass_check
)
```

```{r}
carcass_anova <- dual_purpose_meat |>
  filter(
    !is.na(`Carcass weight (kg)`),
    `Carcass weight (kg)` > 0,
    !is.na(Adaptedness),
    Adaptedness != "NA"
  )

carcass_model <- lm(
  `Carcass weight (kg)` ~ Purpose * Adaptedness,
  data = carcass_anova
)

anova(carcass_model)
```
